# Storage Medium

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:StorageMedium`](gmeow-StorageMedium.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/StorageMedium>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The kind of medium a storage location uses (cloud service, local filesystem, object store, content-addressed store, physical disk, removable media). A value, not a [`StorageLocation`](gmeow-StorageLocation.md) subclass: the kinds share the same structure (path, service, holder, physical place).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

Use [`gmeow:StorageMedium`](gmeow-StorageMedium.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

### Use when

- Use to mint a new storage-medium kind as an individual on the open value vocabulary.

### Avoid when

- Avoid subclassing [`StorageLocation`](gmeow-StorageLocation.md) per medium (the kinds share structure; a new medium is a new individual).

### How to use

- Mint the medium as a [`gmeow:StorageMedium`](gmeow-StorageMedium.md) individual and reference it from a [`StorageLocation`](gmeow-StorageLocation.md) via the functional [`gmeow:storageMedium`](../properties/gmeow-storageMedium.md).
